about_item: Stylish Metallic Clip-On Design with Air Conduction Tech: Step into the future of audio fashion and safety with a striking metallic clip-on build that utilizes open-ear air conduction technology. Instead of blocking your ear canal, these buds clip onto your outer ear like a premium accessory, directing sound waves straight into your ears while keeping you fully aware of your surroundings. It perfectly solves the issue of missing traffic sounds or announcements while jogging or commuting.

4.6g Feather-Light EarBuds: Experience the liberating feeling of audio gear that weighs practically nothing at an ultra-light 4.6 grams per bud. You will completely forget you are even wearing them, making those long, grueling work sessions feel entirely effortless. It solves the physical ear fatigue and soreness that usually comes with wearing heavy, bulky audio equipment.

All-Day Wear Comfort: Engineered for the relentless hustlers, the open-ear ergonomic build guarantees ultimate comfort from morning coffee to your late-night wind-down. Because they sit securely on the outside of your ears without causing any inner-ear pressure, they are perfect for extended listening. They stay firmly in place whether you're pacing around during a marathon meeting or jogging on the track.

Total Playtime Up to 52 Hours: Say goodbye to battery anxiety with a massive 52 hours of combined backup that keeps your soundtrack rolling across days. Imagine going on a spontaneous weekend getaway and entirely forgetting your charging cable, no problem at all! These earbuds pack more than enough power to survive your flights, road trips, and endless streaming playlists.

12 mm Dynamic Drivers: Treat your senses to a rich, expansive audio landscape powered by customized 12 mm dynamic drivers. They push out beautifully detailed mids and sparkling highs that make acoustic tracks and live podcasts sound incredibly crisp. It transforms a mundane desk job into an uplifting sensory experience, keeping your motivation high all day.

Advanced Bluetooth v6.0: Enjoy seamless wireless stability courtesy of the next-generation Bluetooth v6.0 chip. It eliminates the annoying stuttering and frequent audio drops often experienced in signal-heavy environments like crowded offices or public transport. It provides a highly power-efficient, rock-solid connection the instant you get moving.

Private Mode for Zero Sound Leakage: Keep your personal entertainment completely to yourself with an intelligent Private Mode that prevents sound from escaping to people around you. Picture sitting in a completely silent library or next to someone on a quiet flight; you can max out your volume without worrying about bothering your neighbors. Your audio stays locked into your ears only.

AI-Powered Environmental Noise Cancellation: Lock into clear conversations even when life gets loud around you with smart, AI-driven mic tech. The advanced algorithms actively target and suppress distracting background clatter like wind noise or traffic chatter while boosting your voice. It ensures you sound highly professional and crystal clear on every important business call.

Multi-Point Connectivity: Redefine the way you handle multitasking by pairing your open-ear buds to two separate media devices at the same time. If you are watching a movie on your laptop and a time-sensitive call rings your phone, the ProClip shifts the audio stream automatically. It eliminates the old, frustrating routine of manually disconnecting and re-pairing.

boAt Hearables App for Full Control: Take complete charge of your open-ear experience by linking up with our boAt Hearables App. It gives you the power to monitor precise battery and pairing status, fine-tune the sound output to your liking, personalize your touch controls, and easily run device diagnostics. It effectively solves the guesswork of managing your smart audio gear.
